title: A/R Collection: a customer ticked by link is named even if hard to find
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has more than 50 customers (the Customer menu lists at most 50 until you search), and {Customer-A}, who has overdue invoices on today's date, comes after the first 50 in name order.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-24 Late In The List.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Customer filter, search for {Customer-A}.
  2. Tick {Customer-A}.
  3. Copy the page address.
  4. Open a new browser tab.
  5. Paste the copied address into its address bar.
  6. Press Enter.
  7. Read the Customer chip.
  8. Open the Customer menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Customer-A} shows in the list.
  • Step 2: the chip reads "Customer: " and {Customer-A}'s name.
  • Step 3: the address is copied.
  • Step 4: a new, empty tab opens.
  • Step 5: the copied address shows in the address bar.
  • Step 6: the report opens with only {Customer-A}'s group.
  • Step 7: the chip reads "Customer: " and {Customer-A}'s name.
  • Step 8: {Customer-A} is shown ticked in the menu.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R14: “A customer or vendor ticked through a link, a reload or a Summary drill-down is named and ticked on the chip, even when it is not among the first results of the chip's search.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D31: “Customer search (ar-aging/customers) searches all of the organization's customers, as Sales By Customer's chip does; vendor list = all of the organization's vendors, as Inventory Value's chip does”
  • Tech plan §5 API, new endpoints: “ar-aging/customers (search, limit ≤ 50), ap-aging/vendors (org vendor list)”
